QuestInfo.name: Jane's Second Challenge
QuestInfo.1: This time, Jane promises to make an even better item, so she needs you to gather #b1 Mushmom Spore, 3 vials of Drake's Blood, 100 Medicines with Weird Vibes, and 30 Malady's experimental frogs#k. She said something about making Power Elixirs, something that restores both HP and MP.
QuestInfo.2: You got Jane the materials she needed. If she does well, you'll get some nice elixirs. If not...er, you're not sure you really want to take what she gives you...
QuestInfo.0: Jane will make you something better.

0.0: Did you enjoy the stuff I gave you last time? Hehe, now I want to make more complicated stuff. Want to help?

yes.0: Thanks. I need #b1 #t4000040##k, #b3 #t2012000#s#k, #b100 #t4000036##k and #b30 #t4000041#s#k. This time, I'm hoping to make #t2000005#s, hehe!

no.0: Well, now. If you don't have time to listen to a poor girl's plea... Fine, just let me know if you change your mind.

1.0: You got #b1 #t4000040##k, #b3 #t2012000#s#k, #b100 #t4000036##k, and #b30 #t4000041#s#k. Excellent! Time to mix... Heh, heh, heh.
1.1: Okay, this is only my second experiment ever. Hope it turns out okay. Check to make sure you have an empty slot in your Use inventory, and then hold out your hand...
